verdicts.reason: A shrinks the quote so far that the bold attribution outweighs it (hierarchy reversed), leaves 'soon.' orphaned on its own line, pushes the text almost to the left canvas edge, and places the logo awkwardly off-centre on the right; the small product floats above a large empty lower half. B has the same weak quote-vs-attribution hierarchy (the quote is far smaller than in the original), but its margins are proper, there is no orphan, the logo sits centred, and the larger centred bottle balances the format, so it needs fixes but is clearly the better resize.
